interpretation: UG-V is exactly unchanged in every reported metric/view/split across all 16 logical prefixes. In each of the five recoveries, the U64 selected float64 candidate differs from F64, but UG fails the post-cast new-train-KL gate and falls back to a byte alias of V.

UR-UG differs only on the five recovered prefixes; the eleven fixed E163 reuses are exact aliases and contribute zero by construction. UR lowers old KL on all five, while encoded holdout G_new improves on two and degrades on three; full-16 means are diluted by the eleven unchanged rows.

This is a bounded diagnostic of selector, float32 post-cast gate and fallback on five fixed recoveries. It is not reward evidence, a deployment or upgrade rule, a 12-of-16 progression decision, or evidence about general function-class compatibility.
